name: span_piGBar
summary: Compare the two ideals elementwise through valuations at the chosen places.

steps.claim: An element lies in the span of π̄_g if and only if π̄_g divides it, if and only if its valuation at each chosen place is at least that of π̄_g (`dvd_iff_Ô`, the places apart, `mem_prod_finPlace_iff`), and π̄_g has valuation 1 exactly at the two chosen places (`Parameters.intValuation_eq_of_mul_star`, g_i ≡ 1, the cofactor).
steps.lean:
ext; simpa [mem_prod_finPlace_iff D.isConjApart_chosen.1, mem_span_singleton,
    ← dvd_iff_Ô D.piGBar_ne_zero, D.range_chosen, dvd_iff_reduceAt_eq_zero fun h ↦
    (D.isChosen_iff.1 h).rec fun _ ↦ (Parameters.intValuation_eq_of_mul_star (D.g_modEq_one _) ·.2
    D.exists_cofactor h)] using! Set.forall_mem_range (f := D.chosen)
